name: get_project
description: The open project: settings, length, playhead, every track (bottom to top) with its clips, and subtitle tracks. Call this first and after edits to get ids. Times are seconds.

name: list_assets
description: Media in the project (videos, sounds, pictures) with ids for add_clip. The user imports files; an agent can only add library items (add_library_item).

name: get_clip
description: Every setting of one clip (transform, text, shape, audio, effects with params, keyframes), also inside groups. Path shapes include their outline as SVG path data `d` (centred on the shape position).

name: add_clip
description: Put an asset on the timeline at `start`. Without trackId it goes on the top free track that takes it (or a new one). Optional inPoint (seconds into the source) and duration trim it.

name: add_text
description: Add a text clip (title, caption, label) on a graphics track. Defaults: 3 s, white bold 72 px Vazirmatn with a black outline, slightly below centre. Persian/Arabic text is detected and laid out right-to-left.

x.description: Centre offset as a fraction of the frame width: 0 centred, -0.5 left edge, 0.5 right edge

y.description: Centre offset as a fraction of the frame height: 0 centred, -0.5 top, 0.5 bottom

name: add_shape
description: Add a vector shape on a graphics track (a new track on top when the time is taken). Kinds: rectangle, square, circle, oval, triangle, star, polygon, line, and path: any outline with curves from SVG path data `d` or `points` (faces, hair, objects). Sizes are project pixels. Colours may have alpha (#RRGGBBAA). Draw a figure as several paths with the same transform, then group_clips and reorder_clip.

width.description: Pixels. For a path: scales the outline to this width

lineCap.description: Ends of lines and open paths

feather.description: Soft edge of the fill, pixels

gradient.description: Fill from `fill` to `to`; null removes it

shadow.description: Drop shadow, pixels; colour may have alpha (#00000080). null removes it

innerRadius.description: Star, fraction of the outer radius

x.description: Centre offset as a fraction of the frame width: 0 centred, -0.5 left edge, 0.5 right edge

y.description: Centre offset as a fraction of the frame height: 0 centred, -0.5 top, 0.5 bottom

d.description: kind path: SVG path data (M L H V C S Q T A Z, absolute or lower-case relative) in project pixels. (0,0) is the point at transform x/y, so parts drawn with the same transform line up. One subpath (one M) per shape; Z closes it (only closed paths are filled).

points.description: kind path, instead of d: points in pixels (same origin as d), joined by straight lines, or by a curve through them with smooth

smooth.description: points: a smooth curve through the points

name: add_solid
description: Add a full-frame solid colour layer (a background or a colour wash) on a graphics track.

name: update_clip
description: Change a clip (also one inside a group): length, transform (position/scale/rotation/opacity), blend mode, sound (volume 0..2, fades), text style or shape style. shape.d / shape.points replace a shape's outline (it becomes a path), centred where the shape is now. On a clip with keyframes, transform and volume changes land in a keyframe at timeline time `time` (default the clip start).

x.description: Centre offset as a fraction of the frame width: 0 centred, -0.5 left edge, 0.5 right edge

y.description: Centre offset as a fraction of the frame height: 0 centred, -0.5 top, 0.5 bottom

width.description: Pixels. For a path: scales the outline to this width

lineCap.description: Ends of lines and open paths

feather.description: Soft edge of the fill, pixels

gradient.description: Fill from `fill` to `to`; null removes it

shadow.description: Drop shadow, pixels; colour may have alpha (#00000080). null removes it

innerRadius.description: Star, fraction of the outer radius

d.description: kind path: SVG path data (M L H V C S Q T A Z, absolute or lower-case relative) in project pixels. (0,0) is the point at transform x/y, so parts drawn with the same transform line up. One subpath (one M) per shape; Z closes it (only closed paths are filled).

points.description: kind path, instead of d: points in pixels (same origin as d), joined by straight lines, or by a curve through them with smooth

smooth.description: points: a smooth curve through the points

name: move_clip
description: Move a clip to a new start time, optionally onto another track of the same kind. Fails if it would overlap another clip.

name: reorder_clip
description: Change the layer order of a visual clip: what it is drawn in front of or behind (e.g. arms in front of the head). action bringToFront / sendToBack: past every clip it overlaps in time; forward / backward: one step. Or trackIndex (from get_project) to put it on that track. Inside a group the order is among the group's clips.

name: group_clips
description: Group clips (e.g. the parts of a drawn character) into one compound clip that moves, scales, turns and animates as one object about the centre of its parts. The parts keep their ids: get_clip, update_clip, animate, reorder_clip and effects still work on them inside the group.

name: ungroup
description: Break a group (compound clip) apart: its clips go back on the timeline where they are drawn, with the group's position, turn, scale and opacity folded into them.

name: trim_clip
description: Move a clip's start or end edge to timeline time `time` (clamped to the source media and neighbouring clips).

name: split
description: Cut clips in two at timeline time `time`: the given clips, or every clip under that time on unlocked tracks. Returns the ids of the new right-hand parts.

name: delete_clips
description: Delete clips. With ripple, later clips on the same track move left to close the gap.

name: set_speed
description: Play a video or sound clip faster or slower (0.1 to 10; 2 = twice as fast). The clip gets shorter or longer on the timeline.

name: detach_audio
description: Move the sound of video clips onto their own clips on an audio track (the video goes silent).

name: list_effects
description: Effects (with their parameters and ranges), filter presets and transition kinds that can be added.

name: add_effect
description: Add an effect (blur, glow, colour correction…; see list_effects) to visual clips, with optional parameter values.

name: update_effect
description: Change an effect's parameters, turn it on or off, or remove it.

name: set_filter
description: Give visual clips a colour filter preset (see list_effects filterPresets), at `intensity` percent.

name: add_transition
description: Add a transition on the cut between two touching clips of the same track (fromClipId ends where toClipId starts).

name: animate
description: Animate a clip (also a part inside a group, or a whole group) with keyframes at timeline times. Values: x, y, scale, rotation, opacity, volume, and for text text.size; shapes shape.width/shape.height. Ease: linear, easeIn, easeOut, easeInOut (default), hold.

name: clear_keyframes
description: Remove a clip's animation, keeping the values it has at its start.

name: list_templates
description: Ready-made titles, intros, lower thirds and outros that insert_template can add.

name: insert_template
description: Insert a template at `start` on new graphics tracks on top. Its placeholder text can then be changed with update_clip.

persian.description: Use the Persian placeholder text, laid out right-to-left

name: list_library
description: Files in the server's library: stickers, sounds (sound effects and music), overlays (light leaks, dust) or backgrounds.

name: add_library_item
description: Add a library file (see list_library) to the project and the timeline at `start`. Backgrounds go on the bottom video track.

name: list_cues
description: The cues (start, end, text) of a subtitle track, or of the first one.

name: add_subtitles
description: Create a subtitle track from cues you write or from SRT/WebVTT text. Use it for scripted captions; auto_captions transcribes the audio instead.

srt.description: SRT or WebVTT file text, instead of cues

name: edit_cues
description: Change, add or delete subtitle cues. Changes: {cueId, text?, start?, end?}; additions: {trackId, start, end, text}; deletions: cue ids.

name: auto_captions
description: Transcribe the speech in the project into a new subtitle track, in the browser with Whisper. Takes from seconds to minutes: poll job_status. Model: base is fast, large-v3-turbo is best (needs a strong computer).

name: translate_captions
description: Translate an English subtitle track into a new Persian one, in the browser (Pro plan). Poll job_status.

name: snapshot
description: A picture of the video at timeline time `time` (also moves the playhead there). Use it to check how an edit looks.

name: job_status
description: Progress of auto_captions, translate_captions and export.

name: request_export
description: Open the export window with these settings. The user must press Export themselves (the browser asks where to save). Free accounts: up to 60 s and a watermark. Poll job_status.

name: undo
description: Undo the last change (the agent’s or the user’s).

name: redo
description: Redo the last undone change.
